name: Reno9

images.credit: GHEIMKRjuhp HUA, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Platform.Operating system: Initial: Android 13 + ColorOS 13, Current: Android 15 + ColorOS 15
Platform.Chipset: Reno9: Qualcomm SM7325 Snapdragon 778G 5G (6 nm), Reno9 Pro: MediaTek Dimensity 8100-MAX (5 nm), Reno9 Pro+: Qualcomm SM8475 Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 (4 nm)
Platform.CPU: Reno9: Octa-core (1×2.4 GHz Cortex-A78 & 3×2.2 GHz Cortex-A78 & 4×1.9 GHz Cortex-A55), Reno9 Pro: Octa-core (4×2.85 GHz Cortex-A78 & 4×2 GHz Cortex-A55), Reno9 Pro+: Octa-core (1×3 GHz Cortex-X2 & 3×2.75 GHz Cortex-A710 & 4×2 GHz Cortex-A510)
Platform.GPU: Reno9: Adreno 642L, Reno9 Pro: Mali-G610 MC6, Reno9 Pro+: Adreno 730

Memory.RAM: Reno9: 8/12 GB LPDDR4X (8/256 GB and 12/256 GB) or LPDDR5 (12/512 GB), Reno9 Pro/Pro+: 16 GB LPDDR5
Memory.Storage: Reno9: 256 GB UFS 2.2, 512 GB UFS 3.1, Reno9 Pro/Pro+: 512 GB UFS 3.1

Cameras.Rear camera: Reno9: 64 MP, 26 mm (wide), PDAF + 2 MP, (depth sensor), Reno9 Pro: 50 MP Sony IMX766, 26 mm (wide), 1/1.56", 1 µm, multi-directional PDAF + 8 MP, 112˚ (ultrawide), 1/4", 1.12 µm, Reno9 Pro+: 50 MP Sony IMX766, 26 mm (wide), 1/1.56", 1 µm, multi-directional PDAF, OIS + 8 MP, 120˚ (ultrawide), 1/4", 1.12 µm + 2 MP, (depth sensor), LED flash, HDR, panorama, Video:, Reno9/Pro: 4K@30fps, 1080p@30/60/120fps, gyro-EIS, HDR (Reno9 Pro), Reno9 Pro+: 4K@30/60fps, 1080p@30/60/120/240fps, gyro-EIS, OIS, HDR
Cameras.Front camera: 32 MP Sony IMX709, 22 mm (wide), 1/2.74", 0.8 µm, AF, HDR, panorama, Video: 1080p@30fps, gyro-EIS

Battery.Battery: All models: Non-removable Li-Po, Reno9/Pro: 4500 mAh, Reno9 Pro+: 4700 mAh
Battery.Charging: Reno9: 67 W fast charging, Quick Charge 2.0, Reno9 Pro: 67 W fast charging, Reno9 Pro+: 80 W fast charging, Quick Charge 3.0, All models: SUPERVOOC, Power Delivery, Reverse charging

Connectivity.Connectivity: USB-C 2.0, Bluetooth: (A2DP, LE, aptX HD)Reno9/Pro+: 5.2, Reno9 Pro: 5.3 NFC, IR blaster, Wi-Fi 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/6 (dual-band, Wi-Fi Direct), Satellite navigation:Reno9/Pro: GPS (L1; Assisted GPS, A-GPS), GLONASS (L1), BeiDou Navigation Satellite System, BeiDou (B1l), Galileo (satellite navigation), Galileo (E1), QZSS (L1), Reno9 Pro+: GPS (L1 + L5; A-GPS), GLONASS (L1), BeiDou (B1l + B2a + Bc), Galileo (E1 + E5a), QZSS (L1 + L5)
